info.name: Teya FX Captures Print Receipts (ePOS) API
Create a receipt to print (JSON or multipart image)

items.docs:
Creates a receipt print job by either:
 - Sending a JSON payload that describes the receipt content to be rendered by the service; or
 - Uploading a pre-rendered receipt image via multipart/form-data.

 On success, a new receipt job is created and the response contains the unique receipt_id,
 initial status (NOT_PRINTED), and creation timestamp. Clients can then subscribe to status updates via the SSE endpoint or poll for the result.

 Content types:
 - application/json
 - multipart/form-data (f

info.name: Get receipt print job with real-time updates

items.docs:
Streams real-time updates for a receipt print job using Server‑Sent Events (SSE) with content type text/event-stream.

Each message in the stream is an SSE event with:
- data: a JSON object with receipt status fields (no formal schema available for SSE payload)
- a blank line terminates each event frame

Semantics:
- The stream emits receipt status updates as they occur.
- When the receipt reaches a final status (for example, PRINTED or FAILED), a last event is sent and the stream is closed.
